comment: Websites-trail hoop route (the /websites page), in world units after Mountain3D's sinkY (-3) transform. Points tagged with `hoop` are the visible marker hoops, one per /websites section (y = ground + 0.8, so the flat ring sits on the rock; the final `contact` point is the summit and has no ring); the rest are via points that shape the orb's path so it clears the terrain. Switchbacks up the front (south) face, alternating west and east: trailhead -> west ledge -> east bench -> west shelf -> east shelf -> below the summit -> summit. It stays off the infrastructure spiral (front base -> east wall -> back face -> west shoulder) and only meets it at the summit. Hoop labels come from the section badges in src/content/sites.ts. Validate with `npm run test:orb` after editing.
